title: Mella Camelia -  Data Analyst: Supporting Strategic Decision Through Data | BukaTalks
description: A Data Analyst is tasked with processing data into information, so that the characteristics or properties of the data can be easily understood. The expertise possessed by a data analysis can be used to find solutions to a problem.   The problem is related to research activities or other definitions of data analysis. The activity was carried out to change the big data or research data into information that could later be used in decision making in each division in the company.  Bukatalks edition How to Kickstart Your Career in Data, Mella Camelia (Business Analyst at GO-JEK) will explain more deeply what it is and how the business analyst works especially as data analyst to support marketing, operations, and even management levels in processing data to determine various strategies in the company.  Come on, watch the bukatalks video right now!  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Bukatalks: Bukatalks is an initiative from Bukalapak to build a forum for creators and innovators to share inspirational stories for young people, in the format of discussions held routinely every month.   Bukatalks themes are made varied, ranging from technology to art, by presenting topics and speakers who can open the eyes of the audience and provide a new perspective. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Subscribe: http://bl.id/subs-bukalapak  Bukatalks-How to kick-start your career in data: https://www.youtube.com/playlist  Other #bukatalks videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch  Website: https://www.bukalapak.com/  Download the Bukalapak application here iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/id/app/bukalapak-jual-beli-online/id1003169137?l=id  Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bukalapak.android   Like / follow social media bukalapak: Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/bukalapak Twitter - https://www.twitter.com/bukalapak Instagram - https://instagram.com/bukalapak Google Plus - https://plus.google.com/+bukalapakdotcom Community Forum - https://komunitas.bukalapak.com Stack Overflow - https://stackoverflow.com/jobs/companies/bukalapak LinkedIn-https://www.linkedin.com/company/pt-bukalapak-com

label_evidence.text: Mella Camelia - Data Analyst: Supporting Strategic Decision Through Data | BukaTalks

A Data Analyst is tasked with processing data into information, so that the characteristics or properties of the data can be easily understood. The expertise possessed by a data analysis can be used to find solutions to a problem. The problem is related to research activities or other definitions of data analysis. The activity was carried out to change the big data or research data into information that could later be used in decision making in each division in the company. Bukatalks edition How to Kickstart Your Career in Data, Mella Camelia (Business Analyst at GO-JEK) will explain more deeply what it is and how the business analyst works especially as data analyst to support marketing, operations, and even management levels in processing data to determine various strategies in the company.
